title: Poll Message
help: Polls one message from a queue through a cached poll flow. With ackMode AUTO the message is acknowledged on receipt. With ackMode CLIENT the message is held under a lease until acknowledgeMessage or nackMessage with target POLL settles it or the lease expires after pollAckTimeout. Inside a connector owned transaction the message is settled by commit or rollback. Returns timedOut true when the queue is empty.

value.name: configRef
value.helpTip: The connection to use for the operation.

value.name: queueName
value.helpTip: Name of the queue to poll.

value.name: pollTimeout
value.helpTip: Maximum time to wait for a message in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

value.name: ackMode
value.helpTip: AUTO acknowledges the message on the flow's owner thread right after it is handed to this call. CLIENT stashes the message under solace.poll.message for acknowledgeMessage or nackMessage with target=POLL, within the connection's pollAckTimeout.

value.name: selector
value.helpTip: Optional JMS-style selector expression for filtering (e.g., region = 'EU' AND priority > 5). Leave blank to match any message.

value.name: contentType
value.helpTip: The content type the polled message is read with, for example application/json. It wins over the type the message declares. Empty uses the declared type, else the default of the message class. The payload is never inspected. A value without a charset takes the charset the message declares, else UTF-8.

value.name: responseVariable
value.helpTip: Property name where the result JSON is stored. Contains: destination, received, timedOut, messageId, correlationId, payload, contentType, ackMode, leaseDeadline.

value.name: overwriteBody
value.helpTip: Replace the message body in Message Context with the polled message's payload.
